title: planTrackerItemMutation
responsibility: Plan Tracker item writes and their atomic receipt intent from a caller-supplied snapshot.

inputs.name: planTrackerItemMutation.request
inputs.description: A reserved ID for add or a resolved raw row for a transition, plus the command body and optional receipt intent.

inputs.name: planTrackerItemMutation.context
inputs.description: The caller supplies the node, epoch milliseconds and applicable policy or time-zone inputs.

inputs.name: trackerItemInput.body
inputs.description: Incoming fields and aliases from the Tracker API request.

inputs.name: trackerItemInput.context
inputs.description: Clock, source node, candidates and optional launch planner.

inputs.name: trackerItemInput.current
inputs.description: Existing item when updating, omitted for creation.

inputs.name: trackerNextStepFields.value
inputs.description: Decision text supplied when an item is waiting for Daniel’s next step.

inputs.name: trackerMoveOn.item
inputs.description: Tracked item with an open next step.

inputs.name: trackerParkNextStep.item
inputs.description: Tracked item with an open next step.

inputs.name: trackerParkNextStep.body
inputs.description: The future ISO timestamp or Lisbon date from --until.

inputs.name: trackerParkNextStep.context
inputs.description: Current time for validating the requested hold.

inputs.name: trackerResolveItem.item
inputs.description: Current item, including any next step that must remain open.

inputs.name: trackerResolveItem.body
inputs.description: Answer, optional attribution and requested work status.

inputs.name: trackerResolveItem.context
inputs.description: Current clock used for the answer timestamp.

inputs.name: guardTrackerDuplicate.context
inputs.description: Mutation context containing candidate items to compare.

inputs.name: guardTrackerDuplicate.probe
inputs.description: Duplicate search text, scope, and optional force setting.

inputs.name: trackerItemLaunchFields.fields
inputs.description: Item fields collected from the command or API, including kind, placement options, and an optional reminder time.

inputs.name: trackerItemLaunchFields.context
inputs.description: Clock, explicit launch state and approved placement callback for this item mutation.

inputs.name: trackerItemLaunchFields.current
inputs.description: Existing item used for updates. Missing when this request creates an item.

outputs.name: planTrackerItemMutation
outputs.description: Target item ID, journal fields and the original receipt when supplied.

errors.name: TrackerItemRequestError
errors.description: Legacy validation status and message. Duplicate refusals include the 409 code and ranked matches.

inputs.name: trackerMoveOn.item
inputs.description: Tracked item with an open next step.

outputs.name: trackerMoveOn
outputs.description: Completion fields that clear the next step and parking, plus a journal note.

errors.name: TrackerItemRequestError
errors.description: HTTP 409 when the item has no open next step.

inputs.name: trackerParkNextStep.context

outputs.name: trackerParkNextStep
outputs.description: Parking timestamp without clearing the open decision.

errors.name: TrackerItemRequestError
errors.description: HTTP 400 for an invalid or past date and HTTP 409 when no next step is open.
